records.name: Voss Screen
records.biography_en: Voss Screen serves with the Capture Detail of The Card Lock Bureau. The kit includes a compact handheld Hypernormalization Screen with bone frame, indigo fittings and smoked glass facing outward. Hypernormalization assignments send the crew where a dangerous card or an incident has unsettled a district.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Voss Screen treats the equipment check as the first useful part of every briefing.
